enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the KernelScan analyzer should be enabled.

apiBaseUrl.title: API Base URL
apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the KernelScan API.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: KernelScan account API key (`ks_live_…`). The analyzer resolves the product whose kernel version + architecture match the analyzed component, and reports that product's config-aware finding set.

arch.title: Architecture
arch.description: Target architecture used to disambiguate the KernelScan product when multiple products share a kernel version.

cacheMinutes.title: Cache (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: How long a resolved product VEX is cached in memory between analyses.
